title: KNICKS EXTENSION BOMBSHELL! Towns and Hart Are STAYING… But the Writing Is on the Wall for McBride
description:
Ian Begley and Stefan Bondy just gave us the clearest picture yet on the Knicks extension situation. Karl-Anthony Towns is expected to take less than a max, Josh Hart is likely to do the same, and both are staying — but Miles McBride looks like the odd man out after a soft deadline came and went with no agreement.

We break down the Rudy Gobert blueprint and the roughly $45M a year it points to, the trade eligibility rules that keep every door open for the front office, why Jalen Brunson's next contract changes the math, and how James Dolan's second apron line shapes all of it.

Extend Deuce anyway, or trade him for frontcourt help? Tell us in the comments.

#Knicks #NBA #NewYorkKnicks #KarlAnthonyTowns #JoshHart #DeuceMcBride #SecondApron
